 EXHIBIT 99.1
 Exhibit 99.1 
 KANZHUN LIMITED Announces Third Quarter 2026
Unaudited Financial Results 
 BEIJING, November 25, 2026 – KANZHUN
LIMITED (“BOSS Zhipin” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: BZ; HKEX: 2076), a leading online recruitment platform in China,
today announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
 Third Quarter 2026 Highlights 
 | · | Total paid enterprise customers 1 
in the twelve months ended September 30, 2026 were 7.2 million, an increase of 5.9% from 6.8 million in the twelve months ended September 30,
2025. | · | Average monthly active users 2 
for the third quarter of 2026 were 73.0 million, an increase of 14.4% from 63.8 million for the same quarter of 2025. | · | Revenues for the third quarter of 2026
were RMB2,416.2 million (US$360.4 million), an increase of 11.7% from RMB2,163.3 million for the same quarter of 2025. | · | Income from operations for the third quarter
of 2026 was RMB844.8 million (US$126.0 million), an increase of 23.0% from RMB687.1 million for the same quarter of 2025. Adjusted 3 
income from operations for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB1,076.2 million (US$160.5 million), an increase of 19.1% from RMB903.5
million for the same quarter of 2025. | · | Net loss for the third quarter of 2026
was RMB249.2 million (US$37.2 million), compared with net income of RMB775.4 million for the same quarter of 2025. Adjusted net income 
for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB1,065.1 million (US$158.9 million), an increase of 12.3% from RMB948.5 million for the same quarter
of 2025. | 
 Mr. Jonathan Peng Zhao, Founder, Chairman
and Chief Executive Officer of the Company, remarked, “This quarter, the Company continued its steady growth momentum, with the number of users served continuing to grow. In the third quarter,
the average monthly active users on our app reached 73 million, with blue-collar workers, small-to-medium enterprises and users from lower-tier
cities continuing to serve as significant growth drivers. As a national strategic partner and the officially designated human resources
service provider, the Company participated in and sponsored the 48th WorldSkills Competition, steadily enhancing its brand influence and
recognition. The Company has consistently adhered to a user-first philosophy and firmly made long-term, sustained investments in technology
and service capabilities. With the in-depth application of AI technology in the Company’s algorithms and products, the Company has
made tangible progress in a number of areas, including improving algorithmic matching accuracy and the efficiency of communication between
job seekers and recruiters, and has continued to provide users with higher-value services while achieving robust, high-quality growth
in a volatile market environment.
 The Board of the Company announced a new US$500 million share repurchase program, demonstrating the
Board’s confidence in long-term, high-quality growth and its commitment to rewarding the shareholders for their support.”
 Ms. Wenbei Wang, Deputy Chief Financial Officer
of the Company, added, “We are pleased to report that the Company achieved high-quality growth with increases in both revenue and operating margin in the third
quarter, benefiting from our continuously expanding user base and the strong operating leverage brought by our highly efficient business
model. At the same time, we remain committed to investing in research and development to consistently enhance the Company’s monetization
capabilities by providing more efficient, high-value services to users.
 The Company actively utilizes its ample cash reserves and sound
operating cash flow to provide continuous returns to shareholders. Since the beginning of 2026, the aggregate returns to shareholders
provided by the Company through share repurchases and dividends have exceeded US$530 million, surpassing the adjusted net income for
the entire previous year. The new US$500 million share repurchase authorization further reflects the determination of management and the
Board to continue over-delivering on their commitments to shareholder returns.”
 | 1 | Paid enterprise customers are defined as enterprise users and company accounts from which the Company recognizes revenues for online
recruitment services. | 2 | Monthly active users refer to the number of verified user accounts, including both job seekers and enterprise users, that logged on
to the Company’s mobile application in a given month at least once. | 3 | It is a non-GAAP financial measure. Where applicable, prior-period non-GAAP financial measures have been recast to improve comparability
across periods. For more information about non-GAAP financial measures, please see the sections entitled “Non-GAAP Financial Measures”
and “Unaudited Reconciliation of GAAP and Non-GAAP Results.” | 
 1 
 Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results 
 Revenues 
 Revenues were RMB2,416.2 million (US$360.4 million)
for the third quarter of 2026, representing an increase of 11.7% from RMB2,163.3 million for the same quarter of 2025.
 | · | Revenues from online recruitment services
to enterprise customers were RMB2,400.9 million (US$358.1 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an increase of 11.8%
from RMB2,146.8 million for the same quarter of 2025. This increase was mainly driven by the paid enterprise customer growth. | · | Revenues from other services , consisting
primarily of paid value-added services offered to job seekers, were RMB15.3 million (US$2.3 million) for the third quarter of 2026, decreasing
slightly from RMB16.4 million for the same quarter of 2025. | 
 Operating cost and expenses 
 Total operating
cost and expenses were RMB1,574.7 million (US$234.9 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an increase of 6.7% from RMB1,476.2
million for the same quarter of 2025. Total share-based compensation expenses were RMB231.4 million (US$34.5 million) for the third quarter
of 2026, representing an increase of 6.9% from RMB216.4 million for the same quarter of 2025.
 | · | Cost of revenues was RMB323.6 million
(US$48.3 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an increase of 5.1% from RMB307.8 million for the same quarter of 2025,
primarily due to increases in server and bandwidth cost and employee-related expenses. | · | Sales and marketing expenses were RMB585.0
million (US$87.3 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an increase of 48.6% from RMB393.6 million for the same quarter
of 2025, primarily driven by an increase in advertising and marketing expenses. | · | Research and development expenses were
RMB424.8 million (US$63.4 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an increase of 4.1% from RMB408.0 million for the same
quarter of 2025, primarily due to an increase in cloud service fees. | · | General and administrative expenses were
RMB241.3 million (US$36.0 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing a decrease of 34.2% from RMB366.8 million for the same
quarter of 2025, primarily due to an intangible asset impairment recognized in the third quarter of 2025. | 
 Income from operations and adjusted income
from operations 
 Income from operations
 was RMB844.8 million (US$126.0 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an increase of 23.0% from RMB687.1 million
for the same quarter of 2025.
 Adjusted income from operations was RMB1,076.2
million (US$160.5 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an increase of 19.1% from RMB903.5 million for the same quarter
of 2025.
 2 
 Interest and investment income/loss, net 
 Interest and investment loss was RMB1,277.9 million
(US$190.6 million) for the third quarter of 2026, compared with interest and investment income of RMB228.0 million for the same quarter
of 2025. The loss was primarily attributable to an investment loss of RMB1,443.9 million recognized in the quarter from fair value changes
in investments in an investee company that completed its initial public offering in January 2026.
 Income tax expenses/benefit 
 Income tax benefit was RMB161.4 million (US$24.1
million) for the third quarter of 2026, compared with income tax expenses of RMB172.2 million for the same quarter of 2025, a shift primarily
due to a deferred income tax benefit of RMB361.0 million recognized in the quarter related to the investment loss described above.
 Net income/loss and adjusted net income 
 Net loss was RMB249.2 million (US$37.2 million)
for the third quarter of 2026, compared with net income of RMB775.4 million for the same quarter of 2025. The change was primarily driven
by the investment loss described above, despite the year-on-year growth in income from operations.
 Adjusted net income was RMB1,065.1 million (US$158.9
million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an increase of 12.3% from RMB948.5 million for the same quarter of 2025, primarily
driven by an increase in adjusted income from operations, partially offset by an increase in income tax expenses.
 Net income/loss per American depositary
share (“ADS”) and adjusted net income per ADS 
 Basic and diluted
net loss per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB0.55 (US$0.08) and RMB0.55 (US$0.08),
respectively, compared with basic and diluted net income per ADS of RMB1.75 and RMB1.70 for the same quarter of 2025.
 Adjusted basic and
diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB2.38 (US$0.36) and RMB2.34
(US$0.35), respectively, compared with adjusted basic and diluted net income per ADS of RMB2.13 and RMB2.06 for the same quarter of 2025.
 Net cash provided by operating activities 
 Net cash provided
by operating activities was RMB1,262.6 million (US$188.3 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an increase of 7.6%
from RMB1,173.8 million for the same quarter of 2025.
 Cash position 
 As of September 30,
2026, the balance of cash and cash equivalents, short-term time deposits and short-term investments (excluding investments in equity securities)
was RMB19,602.1 million (US$2,923.7 million).
 3 
 Shareholder Return Plan 
 On March 18, 2026, the Company announced
that, subject to the final determination of the Company’s board of directors (the “Board”) and the prevailing market
conditions, the Company expects to allocate no less than 50% of the Company’s adjusted net income (a non-GAAP financial measure)
of the preceding fiscal year for distribution of dividend under the annual dividend policy and share repurchases for each of the next
three years starting from 2026.
 Share Repurchase Program 
 On March 18, 2026, the Board approved amendments
to the share repurchase program, increasing the total authorization under the program to repurchase up to US$400 million of the Company’s
shares (including ADSs) over the extended term of the program through August 28, 2027.
 On November 25, 2026, the Board authorized
a new share repurchase program effective from November 25, 2026 for a 12-month period, under which the Company may repurchase up
to US$500 million of the Company’s shares (including ADSs).
 Outlook 
 For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company
currently expects its total revenues to be between RMB2.19 billion and RMB2.23 billion, representing a year-on-year increase of 5.3%
to 7.3%. This forecast reflects the Company’s current views on the market and operational conditions in China, which are
subject to change and cannot be predicted with reasonable accuracy as of the date hereof.
 Conference Call Information 
 The Company will host a conference call at 7:00
AM U.S. Eastern Time on Wednesday, November 25, 2026 (8:00 PM Beijing Time on Wednesday, November 25, 2026) to discuss the financial
results.
 Participants are required to pre-register for
the conference call at:
 https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIf96c3b4777a9434ba91b0e11741dc9da
 Upon registration, participants will receive an
email containing participant dial-in numbers and a unique personal PIN. This information will allow you to gain immediate access to the
call. Participants may pre-register at any time, including up to and after the call start time.
 Additionally, a
live and archived webcast of the conference call will be available on the Company's investor relations website at https://ir.zhipin.com.
 Exchange Rate 
 This press release contains translations of certain
RMB amounts into U.S. dollar (“US$”) amounts at specified rates solely for the convenience of the reader. Unless otherwise
stated, all translations from RMB to US$ were made at the exchange rate of RMB6.7045 to US$1.00 on September 30, 2026 as set forth
in the H.10 statistical release of the Federal Reserve Board. The Company makes no representation that the RMB or US$ amounts referred
could be converted into US$ or RMB, as the case may be, at any particular rate or at all.
 4 
 Non-GAAP Financial Measures 
 In evaluating the business, the Company considers
and uses non-GAAP financial measures, such as adjusted income from operations, adjusted net income, adjusted net income attributable to
ordinary shareholders, adjusted basic and diluted net income per ordinary share attributable to ordinary shareholders and adjusted basic
and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders as supplemental measures to review and assess operating performance.
The Company defines these non-GAAP financial measures by excluding the impact of share-based compensation expenses and net gains or losses
from investments in an investee company from the related GAAP financial measures. The Company believes that these non-GAAP financial measures
help identify underlying trends in the business and facilitate investors’ assessment of the Company’s operating performance.
 The non-GAAP financial measures are not presented
in accordance with U.S. GAAP and may be different from non-GAAP information used by other companies. The non-GAAP financial measures have
limitations as analytical tools and should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for most directly comparable GAAP financial
measures. The Company encourages investors and others to review its financial information in its entirety and not rely on a single financial
measure.
 A reconciliation of the non-GAAP financial measures
to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures has been provided in the table captioned “Unaudited Reconciliation of GAAP
and Non-GAAP Results” at the end of this press release.

 5 
 About KANZHUN LIMITED 
 KANZHUN LIMITED operates the leading online recruitment
platform BOSS Zhipin in China. The Company connects job seekers and enterprise users in an efficient and seamless manner through its highly
interactive mobile app, a transformative product that promotes two-way communication, focuses on intelligent recommendations, and creates
new scenarios in the online recruiting process. Benefiting from its large and diverse user base, BOSS Zhipin has developed powerful network
effects to deliver higher recruitment efficiency and drive rapid expansion.

means, subject to market conditions and applicable laws and regulations. The Company’s board of directors will periodically review
the share repurchase programs, and may authorize adjustment of their terms and sizes.

 Shareholder Return Plan 
 On March 18, 2026, the Company announced
that, subject to the final determination of the Company’s board of directors (the “Board”) and the prevailing market
conditions, the Company expects to allocate no less than 50% of the Company’s adjusted net income (a non-GAAP financial measure)
of the preceding fiscal year for distribution of dividend under the annual dividend policy and share repurchases for each of the next
three years starting from 2026.
 Share Repurchase Program 
 On March 18, 2026, the Board approved amendments
to the share repurchase program, increasing the total authorization under the program to repurchase up to US$400 million of the Company’s
shares (including ADSs) over the extended term of the program through August 28, 2027.
 On November 25, 2026, the Board authorized
a new share repurchase program effective from November 25, 2026 for a 12-month period, under which the Company may repurchase up
to US$500 million of the Company’s shares (including ADSs).
 Outlook 
 For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company
currently expects its total revenues to be between RMB2.19 billion and RMB2.23 billion, representing a year-on-year increase of 5.3%
to 7.3%. This forecast reflects the Company’s current views on the market and operational conditions in China, which are
subject to change and cannot be predicted with reasonable accuracy as of the date hereof.
